name: NEO broad verified-flow PAPER execution and outcome feedback
policy: A broader market candidate rule joins four selective rules in the shared PAPER account. Every entry still requires fresh confirmed exact-pool flow, completed same-pool safety, independently verified price, executable quotes and strict risk/cost limits. Current-policy closed trades are attributed to matched rules; a rule may be throttled only after at least 12 closes show weak posterior win rate and negative net PnL. This does not establish or promise profitability. Version V4 prospectively adds a mature liquid market candidate rule, shared bounded address discovery, cost-aware tape scheduling, and coordinated quote preparation; all final cost/safety/flow gates are preserved. Funded Lab candidate filters are aligned under separate version V2. No prior ledger is reset or reclassified. Infrastructure repair preserves V4 candidate and execution limits while fixing Windows tape replacement, bounded address discovery, fee-aware quote priority and strict proof of foreign references that executed no Pump swap. No profitable outcome is inferred from these changes. Funded V3 prospectively adds physical established-liquid branches for Momentum and Precision; original young branches and final evidence/cost/risk gates remain. Reversed PumpSwap pool orientation is decoded with exact cash/token legs. No trade frequency or profitable outcome is inferred. DEFENSIVE_ENTRY_LAYER_V1 (2026-10-08) puts STRUCTURAL_RUG_GUARD_V1, POOL_LOSS_MEMORY_V1 and HEAT_VETO_STACK_V1 in front of every PAPER entry path before quotes, flow promotion and RugCheck; it only removes entries, exits and ledgers are unchanged, and the research found no strategy with positive expectancy after costs.
integrity_note: Mandatory fresh confirmed flow coverage, exact pool/mint checks, complete same-pool safety, independent price confirmation, modeled expected round-trip cost at most 1.5%, conservative cost at most 2.5%, bounded quotes and uncapped actual modeled losses.

control_continuity.cash: below the cash minimum the control enters the fixed notional as a zero-capital measurement: same signal, gates, exits, costs and close records; its closes never move the balance (balance_effect_usd 0)
control_continuity.evidence: kill-rule evidence and the gate count funded and zero-capital closes alike

signal_carry.age_basis: the first signal observation of the episode's signal run (first_observed_at), on the Lab clock: a run ends as lost_price_pending once it is more than max_age_ms old (the research fill window, FILL_BASIS.max_fill_lag_ms); a newer match never extends it
signal_carry.retry_basis: the pool's current feed observation; universe, structural guard and loss memory (decision and commit), network price, price cross-check with exact identity, cooldowns, cost cap, cash and retirement are re-run
signal_carry.cooldown_at_signal: a signal whose pool or token cooldown has not ended at its observation is not held (no episode starts; a live one ends as dropped_by_gate reentry_cooldown) and counts as cooldown_rejected, as it would once the price check passed
signal_carry.signal_run: a newer matched observation of a pool with a live episode continues the same signal run: it refreshes the episode's signal (not its window) and, when it is eligible, enters as that run (lab_forward.carry with rematched true); the run's first signal observation stays its research-fill decision; a match after the run expired starts a new run anchored at itself
signal_carry.applies_to: all four books (each hypothesis and its control see the same latency)
signal_carry.jupiter_probe: never requested by these books: the GeckoTerminal exact-pool reference, or a Jupiter tie-break another book already cached, must resolve within the carry

lab_forward_tests.exit_source: the position's stored exit_parameters (lab_forward_tests.position_exits); the book's current exits only when missing or malformed
lab_forward_tests.new_test_rule: a new config hash is a new evidence sample in the same ledger (balance, cash state and retirement carry over); new funding or parameters need new, versioned book ids with fresh ledgers
lab_forward_tests.admission_cost_cap_display: entry_diagnostics publish max_entry_roundtrip_cost_ceiling_pct (2.75), entry_size_rule FIXED_NOTIONAL_NO_BACKOFF and fixed_notional_usd; the dashboard renders min(0.5 x stop, 2.75) when the ceiling binds (LAB_B) and never states 0.5 x stop for it

fill_basis.source: research harness_final F1 (fill_index, FILL_RULE next_refresh, MAX_FILL_LAG_MS)
fill_basis.entry_decision: the first signal observation of the uninterrupted signal run the entry acts on (the signal-carry episode's first signal), as the harness enters at the first signal point and fills fill_index there: its leg is advanced by every later observation of the pool the book evaluates (carried retries and newer matches alike) and then by the entry observation; a run enters only while its first signal is at most 60 s old on the Lab clock (LAB_FORWARD_SIGNAL_CARRY_V2 max_age_ms, the harness never fills more than max_fill_lag_ms after its decision); an entry without a run is decided at its entry observation; the same rule for every hypothesis and control
fill_basis.observations: the shared feed's exact-pool observations and the exact-pair refresh (updatedAt, as PairHistory), each counted once, in stamp order; an observation without liquidity.usd counts at a reported liquidity of 0 (LAB_FORWARD_MARK_LIQUIDITY_V2)
fill_basis.valuation: the booked model (Lab spot model + the position CALIB_V1 bps per leg, drain-aware exit) re-run at the entry and exit fill observations; net50 with the booked stress and exit-reason extra
fill_basis.applies_to: every forward position and close (shadow only: booked P&L, balance and exits unchanged)
fill_basis.kill_rule: evaluated on both bases; met on either retires
fill_basis.gate: expectancy, CI and same-period control criteria must pass on both bases

mark_liquidity.rejected_alternative: substituting the last known liquidity: an LP pull keeps its price, so an omitted-field drain would be booked near 0%

lab_forward_tests.jupiter_probe: never scheduled for these books (strategy_lab schedules schedule_jupiter_price_probe for other books only; signal_carry.jupiter_probe in every config hash)

lab_forward_tests.persist_metrics: LAB_PERSIST_METRICS_V1: strategy_lab.persistence publishes the previous ledger write's ledger_bytes, compact_bytes, write_seconds and write_share_of_poll; the ledger is serialized with json.dumps (C encoder, byte-identical to the former streaming json.dump, about 3x faster) and written in one call; runbook action threshold: write_share_of_poll >= 0.5 calls for an owner decision on archiving Lab history or writing the full ledger only when it changes
lab_forward_tests.signal_run: LAB_FORWARD_FILL_BASIS_V4 with LAB_FORWARD_SIGNAL_CARRY_V2: a signal-carry episode is one uninterrupted signal run that lasts at most max_age_ms (60 s, the research fill window) after its first signal observation, on the Lab clock; a newer matched observation of a held pool continues it without extending that window (SignalCarry.continued_evaluation, lab_forward.carry.rematched, entry_diagnostics.lab_forward.rematched_carried_signals) and keeps the run's first signal observation as the research-fill decision (research_fill.entry_decision first_signal_observation), for every hypothesis and control alike; a run past its window ends as lost_price_pending and a later match is the first signal of a new run, so no entry is decided more than 60 s before the refresh that entered it; a signal inside its pool or token cooldown is not held (cooldown_rejected, reentry_cooldown), since the harness skips such signal points

lab_high_frequency.owner_request: 2026-10-09: "it has to trade more often like 50 trades per hour for each strategy"
lab_high_frequency.config_hash_basis: sha256 of json.dumps(book_parameters(book_id), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True) (the lab_forward_tests basis); it covers the family version, role and control, universe, refresh event, signal, book rules, pool rule, exit, fills, print guard, accounting, defensive modes, the resolved Lab cost model and the kill rule; the pinned values are those of the pre-registered default cost model (no NEO_LAB_* override)
lab_high_frequency.budget_hash_basis: sha256 of the canonical budget parameters (start balance, daily cap, session rotation, capital floor); a budget change never starts a new evidence sample, a strategy-hash change starts one in the same ledger

budget.cap_basis: booked P&L of today's (UTC) closes plus the sum of min(0, open booked marks)
budget.cap_action: no new orders until 00:00 UTC; ORDERED entries and open slots run to exit; a cap row
budget.session_rule: UTC day d = floor(ms / 86,400,000); new orders only from hour (session_step_hours x d) mod 24 (hf_session_not_open before)
budget.session_step_note: 17 h is coprime with 24, so the window visits every UTC hour over 24 days (as 7 h did); chosen so the first deployed day (2026-10-09, d = 20735) opened at 07:00 UTC, the hour the family went live, instead of 17:00

signal.turnover: volume.m5 / liquidityUsd at the decision observation (no volume: no signal)

signal.window: priceUsd / the minimum priceUsd of the pool's observations in (updatedAt - window_ms, updatedAt] (current one included) - 1 <= max_above_low (price <= 1.002 x the 15-min low, research form); the pool's HF memory must reach back to updatedAt - window_ms, else hf_dip15_history_warming

universe.feed: the Lab's main /state feed; every candidate passes lab_activity.usable_feed_coin
universe.roundtrip_basis: strategy_lab.entry_execution + exit_execution at the decision observation, uncalibrated; logged on every order, never size-reduced
universe.structural_rug_guard: STRUCTURAL_RUG_GUARD_V1 enforced at the decision (defensive layer) and again on the entry fill observation (hf_structural_block_at_fill); fail closed

refresh_event.basis: a new (pairAddress, updatedAt) observation of the main feed whose priceUsd differs from the same pool's previous observation, which is at most max_previous_age_ms older
refresh_event.memory: last (updatedAt, priceUsd) per pool from the main feed only; a pool unseen for 61 min is dropped

book_rules.reservation: the min_order_balance_usd is reserved at order time (balance - reservations of unclosed slots must cover it) and released at the close or cancel
book_rules.pool_held: from the order until its exit fill (or cancel)
book_rules.governor_basis: decision observation time (updatedAt); an order counts even if it is later cancelled
book_rules.cost_model: the resolved Lab cost model must equal lab_forward_tests.PREREGISTERED_COST_MODEL, else every book refuses orders (hf_cost_model_mismatch, fail closed)

pool_rule.cooldown_after: the book's exit fill (its observation time) or cancel (Lab clock) on the pool; compared with the decision observation time
pool_rule.replaces: POOL_LOSS_MEMORY_V1 for these books only (shadow: plm_v1_would_block on every order and close)
pool_rule.plm_shadow: pool_loss_memory.index over the book's in-memory closes of the last 6 h

exit.trigger: the first observation of the pool with updatedAt >= decision_at + hold_ms that is also later than the entry fill

defensive.call: DefensiveEntryLayer.evaluate(coin, now, blocked_pools={}, heat_log_only=False), once per pool per refresh
defensive.pool_loss_memory_acceptance: Acceptance record: the owner accepts this replacement by merging this change into main (GitHub records who merged it and when; that merge is the written acceptance of this wording); no agent can accept it, an agent never merges to main, and the HF books are deployed only from main. What it accepts: POOL_LOSS_MEMORY_V1 runs as a shadow for the three LAB_HIGH_FREQUENCY_V1 books only (plm_v1_would_block on every order and close) and is replaced there by HF_POOL_RULE_V1 (120 s pool cooldown, no loss brake). Basis: the owner's request of 2026-10-09, verbatim "it has to trade more often like 50 trades per hour for each strategy", asks for the rate and does not itself mention POOL_LOSS_MEMORY_V1; the replacement was proposed on 2026-10-09 by the Claude Code workflow that built the family, because about 99% of HF closes lose by construction and with the memory enforced the books traded 3.5-4.0 times an hour on the holdout. Every other account, Lab book and the training probe keeps enforcing it.

fills.source: research harness_final F1 (fill_index); both legs lab_forward_tests.new_fill_leg / advance_fill_leg with FILL_BASIS
fills.fill: the first later exact-pool observation whose priceUsd differs from the leg decision print, within max_fill_lag_ms (next_refresh); none: the first later observation (quiet, resolved at the window end)
fills.entry_no_next: cancel hf_entry_no_next_observation and release the slot
fills.exit_no_next: wait for the next observation and fill there (late_next_observation)
fills.marks: the shared feed exact pool, else HF's own lab_position_marks.PositionMarkFeed (its own worker, pending set and cache; at most one exact-pair request every mark_request_interval_s), never the Lab's POSITION_MARK_FEED, so an HF refresh never queues ahead of an existing Lab position
fills.vanish: no new usable mark for vanish_after_ms while the shared feed is alive (and this process has looked for vanish_confirm_ms): VANISHED at the last mark minus the haircut (lab_forward_tests.vanished_coin)
fills.feed_gap: a held pool that returns after more than feed_gap_ms: FEED_GAP at min(pre-gap price, return price); a return at liquidity 0 values at the return
fills.drained: reported liquidity 0 values the sale at 0 (drain-aware booked exit)
fills.restart: ORDERED slots are cancelled (restart); OPEN slots resume and an overdue exit is ordered at the first observation after the restart (late_exit_restart); EXIT_ORDERED legs keep resolving

print_guard.toggle: a step |dp| >= toggle_step_pct between consecutive main-feed observations whose price comes back within toggle_return_pct of the pre-step price within toggle_window_ms; known at the return observation; the pool is ineligible for every HF book for toggle_block_ms
print_guard.outlier_valuation: a fill print >= outlier_fill_pct away from its leg decision print is valued at the less favourable of the two (buy: higher, sell: lower), flag fill_outlier
print_guard.gain_cap: exit valuation price <= gain_cap_ratio x entry valuation price, flag gain_capped

accounting.booked: strategy_lab.calibrated_entry_execution(fill coin, 25, calib) and calibrated_exit_execution(fill coin, qty, calib, drain_aware=True) at the print-guarded fill prices
accounting.calibration_basis: lab_forward_tests.calib_extra_bps_per_leg(fee tier at the entry fill, liquidity at the entry fill, 25) total_bps per leg (CALIB_V1)
accounting.net50: lab_forward_tests.net50(booked pnl, 25, reason) with reason HF_TIME_120, VANISHED or FEED_GAP
accounting.net0: uncalibrated entry_execution / exit_execution at the same valuation prices
accounting.research_fill: LAB_FORWARD_FILL_BASIS_V4 shape (leg statuses, fill prices, lags, net50) re-valued at the leg fill observations; booking is at the research fill, minus_booked_usd is 0
accounting.decision_print_shadow: the same trade at the decision print and the exit trigger print, booked model without the print guard (what other Lab books book): pnl_usd, net50_usd
accounting.price_audit: log-only: pair_price_integrity.cached at both fills (status, deviation_pct, reference_age_ms); pair_price_integrity.check (schedules a GeckoTerminal fetch) at decisions, at most price_audit_max_checks_per_minute in any rolling 60 s across all HF books; never blocks; no Jupiter or RugCheck call

cap.basis: booked P&L of today's (UTC) closes plus the sum of min(0, open booked marks)
cap.action: no new orders until 00:00 UTC; ORDERED entries and open slots run to exit; a cap row
cap.session_rule: UTC day d = floor(ms / 86,400,000); new orders only from hour (session_step_hours x d) mod 24 (hf_session_not_open before)

kill.action: retire permanently: no new orders; open slots run to exit; balance and journal untouched
kill.capital_floor: equity (balance + open booked marks) <= budget capital_floor_fraction x start balance
kill.applies_to: statistical checkpoint: hypotheses only, on the closes of their current strategy config
kill.gap_rule: hypothesis mean net50_pct - control same-period mean net50_pct <= the control CI half-width (bootstrap of the control same-period net50_pct); all three conditions retire
kill.control_continuity: the control enters while any hypothesis can; it retires when every hypothesis is retired or on its own floor (hypotheses then run with control_retired)
kill.per_config_state: the checkpoint state (cfg, next_checkpoint, last, checkpoints) belongs to the current config hash; after a strategy-hash change the new sample is first evaluated at first_checkpoint_closes of its own closes and min_utc_days_with_closes, never at the old sample's next threshold; the old last evaluation is kept as previous and the dashboard shows the current sample only (lab_high_frequency.kill_state_for)

storage.journal: strategy_lab_hf/journal/<BOOK>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl (HF_JOURNAL_V1, append-only); one flush + fsync per touched file per Lab loop: update and on_refresh only append, strategy_lab.hf_end_loop flushes (HighFrequencyLab.flush_journal) before persist checkpoints; a kill checkpoint flushes once more before it reads the journal
storage.checkpoint: strategy_lab_hf/state.json (HF_CHECKPOINT_V1, atomic, every 15 s when changed and on stop, after the journal); never written while a journaled row is not fully applied (a stop or an error inside _emit; checkpoint.skipped_in_flight); a restart replays rows above the checkpoint seq exactly once
storage.dashboard: compact projection key high_frequency only (<= 16 KB)
storage.reset: a Lab reset flag moves journal/ and state.json into strategy_lab_hf/archive/reset-<ms>-<id>/; paper_state_reset.reset_all_offline moves the whole strategy_lab_hf/ into a reset archive (manifest directory strategy_lab_hf, nested paths) and recreates it empty; nothing is deleted
storage.restore: paper_state_reset.restore_archive (paper_runtime.py restore) restores a manifest with directory: every sha256 and size checked first, unsafe paths refused, the current directory moved into a new reset archive, the archived tree copied back (the archive stays intact)
storage.test_isolation: scripts/run_python_checks.py points NEO_STRATEGY_LAB_HF_DIR at its temp dir and clears the NEO_LAB_HF_* knobs; a test that runs strategy_lab.main() never builds a real HF root
storage.journal_identity: (book, cfg, epoch, seq): every row carries the journal epoch, one id per journal lineage (16 hex characters), new when the HF root starts empty or is reset (where seq and trade_no restart at 1), kept in state.json (or taken from the newest journal row when the checkpoint is unreadable); paper_edge_report --lab-hf and paper_lab_metrics.measure_hf_rows dedupe by it, so archived and current sessions can be read together
storage.torn_lines: journal files are read as bytes, one line at a time (HighFrequencyLab journal reads and paper_lab_metrics.read_hf_journal): a line torn by a crash, also inside a multi-byte UTF-8 character of a symbol, is one malformed line (counted, skipped, never removed) and never stops load(), the kill checkpoint or the reports

process.env_scope: set every NEO_LAB_HF_* variable at User scope before Start: the watchdog scheduled task restarts the Lab with its own environment, so a shell-only value is lost at the next watchdog recovery (docs/PAPER_RUNBOOK.md)
process.calls: HF.update after update_positions every loop; HF.on_refresh after maybe_open at each refresh; hf_end_loop at the end of the loop (the one journal flush, the time budget, the loop errors); each in its own try/except
process.errors: STATE hf_error (the latest loop) passed through the compact projection to main GET /state as strategy_lab.hf_error; persistence.hf.errors {count, last, last_at, consecutive_loops}; the dashboard view last_error for 10 minutes; a persist-time checkpoint failure is reported and the metrics are still published

time_budget.action: hf_degraded: no new orders, exits continue; clears after at least min_degraded_ms and clear_after_loops consecutive loops within budget (hysteresis: a degraded loop does no order work and is fast by construction)

process.mark_feed: HF_MARK_FEED_V1: strategy_lab.HF_MARK_FEED = lab_high_frequency.new_mark_feed(), HF's own lab_position_marks.PositionMarkFeed (own worker, pending set and cache; one exact-pair request at most every 2 s, only for held HF pools out of the main feed); the Lab books keep POSITION_MARK_FEED to themselves, so an HF refresh never queues ahead of an existing Lab position (HighFrequencyLab refuses POSITION_MARK_FEED); the Lab process's exact-pair requests are at most 60 + 30 a minute
process.build_retry: a failed HF build is retried every HF_BUILD_RETRY_MS (60 s) while NEO_LAB_HF_ENABLED is 1 (hf_retry_build); each failure sets hf_error (build: <error>); persistence.hf.build and activity_config.lab_high_frequency.build publish attempts, failures, last_error, last_attempt_at, next_attempt_at and built_at; a reset load that made its archive clears the reset request, so a retry never archives the fresh root again; the dashboard names a failed start or a disabled family instead of only "no HF data"
process.refresh_metrics: persistence.hf.refresh is the last Lab refresh only (0 events about one read in three: the Lab refreshes every 2 s, main rescans every 3 s); persistence.hf.refresh_60s (refreshes, events, universe, refreshes_with_universe, last_universe_at over the last 60 s) is the rollout check

lab_high_frequency.cost_model_mismatch: every HF book refuses orders (hf_cost_model_mismatch, fail closed) when the resolved Lab cost model differs from lab_forward_tests.PREREGISTERED_COST_MODEL

evidence.with_daily_cap_100: closes 137-159 and 2.8-3.5 trading hours per book per UTC day; -$100 booked, about -$137 net50 per day
evidence.parity: syn_lib.py = hf_signals/hfsim.py (1,814 trades, 0 mismatches); the Lab container reproduces syn_lib on the parity fixture (41 orders, fill times, booked and net0)

lab_high_frequency.fills_restart_outage: restart rule precedence (behaviour of HF_FILL_NEXT_REFRESH_V1 as hashed, recorded): when more than feed_gap_ms pass between a held slot's last mark before a stop and its first observation after the restart, the FEED_GAP rule (min(pre-gap, return)) takes precedence over late_exit_restart; a pool that does not come back closes VANISHED; both close rows carry restart_gap true, restarted_at, restart_outage_ms (previous checkpoint to restart) and gap_ms, and the dashboard flag restart_gap; a gap after the restart (slot marked by the new process) is never flagged; an exit leg that resolved but could not be closed fills at the next observation (late_next_observation)
